The first and last underlying forms remain qualified as t and a. The visible live word is no longer doubted wholesale; the overtyped ink omitted by both witnesses is retained in place.
Each quote is a pair of high parallel short strokes, not a pair of angle marks.

The acute, r shoulder, e loop, s curve, tall crossed t and final e are legible above en. A curved leader runs beneath the addition, turns upward at the right and descends at its left into the gap before en. The word and leader are reproduced above the base text.

The i-m-p-o-s-é forms and acute are visible. The right image boundary immediately follows the é and provides no paper on which a possible further e could be checked. C’s alternative is retained as an edge uncertainty, without supplying a grammatical ending.

Every agreed word, sign, accent and punctuation mark was compared with the ink line by line; both halves were viewed again after the detailed decisions. All57 recorded crops were actually viewed, including all differences/cancellations, three rotated handwritten additions and their leader geometry, every math-critical lambda/exponent and each K-bullet/D(X), the clipped right edges, the final cancellation and archive120. Underlines, quotation strokes and final cancellation extent were checked. Both witnesses miss internal overtyped characters in différentiable and opérations. Some old letters and the printing order of overlapping a/u remain qualified. The word imposé is legible but its ending is clipped at the image boundary; no grammatical correction is made. Coéfficients, chaines and au dessus are preserved as typed. The smooth tall parentheses around dit... and de caractéristique... are tagged as handwritten; this identity-only macro distinction is not counted as a collation difference. The final Le cas de la caractéristique is struck through; the preceding full stop and parenthesis are live. Archive120 remains a comment. No mathematical assertion has been checked. Context remains sealed, and no ordered second audit is claimed.
